supporting_observations.claim: A plausible legitimate backup activity is visible shortly before the alert: CobaltVault's approved cvagent.exe ran on FILE-HD-01 as svc-bkp with the Nightly job and the approved ingest.cobaltvault.net target.

The records do not show the alerted hundreds-of-MB transfer. The associated proxy activity shows only small setup/response byte counts, an authentication-required response, and the cvagent process ending at 13:45:58—before the reported activity around 13:46.
The backup job is a plausible explanation to investigate, but the evidence does not establish that it produced the alerted transfer or that the alert itself is represented in these records.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records do not provide a flow or egress-volume record identifying the destination, duration, or bytes for the reported hundreds-of-MB transfer.

The available proxy records around the candidate backup activity show small byte counts and an authentication-required response, but do not establish whether another session or transfer occurred outside the captured records. Relevant records: T010-00322, T010-00323, T010-00329.
claims_not_established: That the CobaltVault process completed a large upload or was responsible for the alert.
The destination, content, or purpose of the reported large outbound transfer.
Whether the reported transfer was authorized or malicious.
additional_evidence_needed: Obtain firewall, NetFlow, or equivalent egress records for FILE-HD-01 around 13:46 UTC, including destination, session duration, and byte counts.
Retrieve complete proxy records for the alert window, including any sessions not represented in the supplied excerpt and their upload/request details.
Review CobaltVault job history and agent logs for the Nightly run, including whether an upload began, completed, failed, or retried.
Correlate endpoint network telemetry with process IDs and outbound connections on FILE-HD-01 during the alert window.
unrelated_findings: FILE-HD-01 used a GlobalProtect user agent to contact updates.paloaltonetworks.com; the inventory does not approve remote-access services, so review separately. Records: T010-00123, T010-00124.

FILE-HD-01 used a Zscaler Client Connector user agent to contact Zscaler endpoints; this is not listed among the approved services. Review separately. Records: T010-00234, T010-00235, T010-00271, T010-00272.
FILE-HD-01 made a curl-identified proxy request to downloads.cloud.com, which is not among the approved file-sharing or cloud-storage services. Review separately. Records: T010-00515, T010-00516.
PROXY-HD-01 initiated an SMB connection to FILE-HD-01. The supplied inventory does not describe this access, so review separately. Records: T010-00248, T010-00249, T010-00250, T010-00251.
